ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the butterflies disappeared from the ecosystem, which organism would benefit?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram; on the right side a butterfly can be seen, with flowering plants/plants nearby; the diagram also includes organisms such as deer, snake, mouse, hawk, grass, etc. The butterfly is associated with plants in the food web. Reasoning: The question asks if butterflies disappear from the ecosystem, which organism would benefit. According to food web rules, after a consumer disappears, the organisms it feeds on or uses will have reduced feeding pressure. Butterflies depend on plants, so after butterflies disappear, plants will benefit.
